verdict.rationale: Puzzle documents its own API: an Embedded Accounting API page and a help article on API access. However, that article frames the API as built 'for deep platform-to-platform integrations', which suggests it is partner-oriented rather than openly self-serve, and the probe found no OpenAPI or Swagger spec. The MCP integration is a separate capability and is not credited here. Missing for 10: confirmed self-serve public access for individual users, published API reference or OpenAPI spec, endpoint and auth documentation, hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote: With Puzzle's Embedded Accounting—powered by our API, your platform gets automated AI bookkeeping
Our API was originally architected for deep platform-to-platform integrations.
